newsitem.title: USA: BlowOut Video Q3 same store sales rise.
newsitem.headline: BlowOut Video Q3 same store sales rise.

text.p: BlowOut Video Inc said on Monday its same store sales for the quarter ending Sept. 30 rose to $3.97 million, a 7.4 percent increase from $3.69 million one year ago.
The sales figures were based on 95 stores, the company said in a statement.

BlowOut Video said it had more than doubled its stores to 192 as of Sept. 30, 1996. The company operates full service, full line video departments inside the stores of mass merchant retailers and supermarket chains.
